subject: SIG follow-up: deployment responsibility matrix for Hosted / Dedicated / Private
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmepay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG follow-up: deployment responsibility matrix for Hosted / Dedicated / Private

Alex —

Thanks again for sending over the initial SIG. To speed up completion on our side, we prepared a short responsibility matrix that maps Redwood vs customer responsibilities across the three deployment modes you asked about (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). The goal is to make it straightforward which SIG questions are "Redwood answer", "Customer answer", or "Depends on deployment".

High level overview (full matrix attached):
- Hosted (Redwood API): Redwood operates the control plane and serving runtime. We provide SOC 2 controls, encryption-in-transit and at-rest, and shared-tenant logical isolation. Customer is responsible for API keys and integration security.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): Redwood owns the serving runtime and infra management, but capacity is dedicated to your account. For SIG items about tenant isolation, data separation and physical access, the answer is a mix: Redwood provides the controls and attestation; you have isolation guarantees and can request configuration snapshots/trace logs.
- Private / VPC / On‑prem: Customer owns the compute/network boundaries; Redwood provides the control plane and software bundle (optional air‑gapped packaging). For several SIG questions (key management, on‑prem patching, network segmentation), the customer will be the responsible party — we'll annotate the questionnaire accordingly.

Next steps I recommend:
1) See the attached redwood_deployment_matrix.csv — we've annotated the SIG questions that typically vary by deployment (column: "who_answers").
2) If you can tell us which deployment you plan to certify against (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), we'll pre-populate the SIG and return a draft for your review.
3) If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough to go over the annotations.

Attachments: redwood_deployment_matrix.csv (CSV stub, per-question mapping), redwood-sig-exhibit.pdf (supporting docs and screenshots).

If you want a different format (e.g., a filled-in .xlsx of your SIG), say the word and we'll match it to your template.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0189

--
Attachment stubs: redwood_deployment_matrix.csv (24kb text), redwood-sig-exhibit.pdf (1.2MB PDF)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmepay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: sig@acmepay.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: deployment responsibility matrix for Hosted / Dedicated / Private

Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the matrix. A couple quick clarifications from our security team:
1) We're primarily evaluating Dedicated for our pilot, but procurement wants to understand the gap to Private so they can price potential future work.
2) For KMS and customer-controlled keys: in Dedicated, do we have a BYOK option where keys never leave our cloud KMS?
3) Can you flag the SIG questions that require vendor-provided evidence (e.g., SOC 2 report, penetration test report, AKS node images) vs questions we as the customer will need to supply artifacts for?

Attaching our SIG in the format our security team uses (acmepay-sig-questions.pdf) — it's long but annotated on our side.

Appreciate it — once we have the pre-populated draft for Dedicated, we'll circulate internally.

Alex Chen
Security Program Manager, AcmePay
alex.chen@acmepay.com

--
Attachment: acmepay-sig-questions.pdf (client SIG export)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmepay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: deployment responsibility matrix for Hosted / Dedicated / Private

Alex —

Thanks — great questions. Short answers up front, followed by the annotated approach we'll include in the draft SIG: 

1) Dedicated vs BYOK: Yes, Dedicated supports a BYOK workflow where customer-managed keys (KMS) can be used for data-at-rest encryption for your reserved capacity. Keys can remain in your cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or Azure Key Vault) and we store only wrapped key material. We'll flag the SIG items that reference KMS ownership and provide an inline note about BYOK steps.

2) Evidence vs customer-supplied artifacts: In the attached matrix we've added an "evidence_owner" column. Typical mapping: 
  - Redwood-provided: SOC 2 Type II report, summary of penetration testing (redacted), vendor security questionnaire summaries, and runtime configuration screenshots. 
  - Customer-provided: network diagrams for Private deployments, cloud IAM policies for BYOK verification, and in some cases on‑prem physical access attestations. 

3) What we'll deliver in the pre-populated Dedicated draft: 
  - Answers populated with our recommended wording.
  - Footnotes where the answer depends on your configuration (e.g., KMS BYOK enabled? Then answer X; otherwise answer Y).
  - A short "evidence checklist" listing what Redwood will attach vs what we expect from AcmePay.

I attached an updated redwood_deployment_matrix.csv (same filename; we incremented the internal version) and the redwood-sig-exhibit.pdf with the SOC 2 index and sample config screenshots. See the CSV for per-question guidance (column headings: question_id, who_answers, evidence_owner, note).

If Dedicated is your pilot, we'll mark the majority of tenant-isolation and runtime controls as Redwood-owned but show the BYOK and network controls as "shared". If later you opt for Private, we will switch the "who_answers" to customer for several items and include handoff artifacts for your security team.

Would you be available for a 30-minute sync Tuesday 08/24 at 10:00 AM PDT to walk through the annotated SIG and the evidence checklist? If that doesn't work, propose two times and we'll coordinate.

Thanks — looping in Priyom (security) and Karthik (solutions) to ensure we capture any technical follow-ups.

Best,
Laura

--
Attachment stubs: redwood_deployment_matrix.csv (updated), redwood-sig-exhibit.pdf (SOC 2 index + screenshots)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmepay.com>

Alex —

Quick note: we can run the Dedicated pilot with BYOK and provide an export of the KMS wrap/unwrap logs for your audit team. Happy to cover that in the sync tomorrow.

I'll bring a short runbook that shows exactly which SIG questions change depending on BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
